full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic still shows a young woman framed closely between two men against a nearly black background. The composition is tight, with heads and shoulders filling the middle and upper frame and the lower half falling into shadow. The woman sits at the center, looking slightly downward and to the left of the camera. Her short dark hair and bangs surround a pale face with darkly defined eyes and lips. She wears a dark textured coat or wrap, its folds visible only where a narrow highlight catches them. At the left, a man leans close in profile toward her ear; his face is softly lit along the cheek and nose but his body merges into black. At the right foreground, another man's head and shoulder are turned toward her, close to the lens and therefore soft and partially out of focus. His lighter hair catches the strongest upper highlight, while his facial features remain a dark side view. The three faces form a compact triangle, with the woman's clear gaze and mouth positioned between the two softer profiles. A hard but narrow source from above and slightly left illuminates her forehead, nose bridge, and cheek, leaving one side of the face and most clothing in deep shadow. Black negative space surrounds the group and erases details of the room, giving their proximity an uncertain emotional charge. Grainy photographic texture softens the bright skin and shadow transitions; the image still retains crisp contrast around the central eyes and lips. There are no readable words or props. The overall composition is intimate and tense, using shallow focus, unequal illumination, and dense black space to make a quiet moment feel dramatic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白电影画面呈现一名年轻女子，在近乎黑色背景中被两名男子近距离围住。构图紧密，头部和肩膀填满中部与上部，下半幅沉入阴影。女子位于中央，目光略向下并落在镜头左侧。短深发与刘海围着浅色面孔，眼睛和嘴唇由深色清楚界定。她穿深色有肌理的外套或披肩，仅在狭窄高光触及时看见衣褶。左边一名男子侧脸靠向她耳旁；脸颊和鼻沿有柔光，身体则并进黑色。右前景另一名男子的头和肩转向她，因贴近镜头而柔软且部分失焦。较浅头发接住上方最强的亮光，面部特征仍是暗色侧影。三张脸形成紧凑三角，女子较清楚的目光与嘴位于两道较柔侧脸之间。来自上方稍偏左的狭窄硬光照亮她的额头、鼻梁与脸颊，让脸的另一侧和大部分衣物留在深影中。黑色留白包围三人，抹去房间细节，使他们的亲近带有难以确定的情绪张力。颗粒状摄影肌理柔化明亮皮肤和影调过渡，中央眼唇附近仍保持清楚反差。没有可读词语或道具。整体构图亲近且紧张，利用浅景深、不均照明和密实黑色空间让安静瞬间带有戏剧性。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white cinematic photography relies on deep near-solid blacks, selective pale highlights, and a narrow band of middle gray. Lighting falls on only a few focal planes, letting adjacent forms and the setting merge into shadow. Close framing compresses separate volumes into one dense arrangement, while shallow focus leaves near and side elements softer than the central point of attention. Grain gives the luminous surfaces a filmic texture and prevents the tonal transition from looking clinically smooth. Edges are sharp only where light meets the key contour; elsewhere they disappear into darkness. The composition favors asymmetrical overlap and a small illuminated center surrounded by generous black negative space. Subtle changes of head-level value and texture carry the visual rhythm without color. The overall effect is intimate, severe, and emotionally charged, built from selective visibility rather than elaborate setting detail.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白电影摄影依靠深而近乎实黑的区域、选择性浅亮部和狭窄中灰带。光只落在少数焦点色面，让相邻形体与环境融合进阴影。近距离裁切把分离的体积压成一个密集安排，浅景深使近处和侧边元素比中央注意点更柔。颗粒赋予发亮表面胶片质地，避免明度过渡显得临床式平滑。仅在光遇到关键轮廓时边缘清楚，其余则消失进黑暗。构图偏向不对称重叠和被大量黑色留白包围的小亮中心。头部高度的细微明度与肌理变化无需颜色便承载视觉节奏。整体效果亲近、严峻而富情绪张力，由选择性可见度而非繁复环境细节建立。
theme_en: A young woman framed closely between two men in deep black-and-white shadow
theme_zh: 深黑白暗影中，一名年轻女子被两位男子近距离围住
name: Rainer Werner Fassbinder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
